committed_correction_review.description: Required dormant policy materialized during setup and activated only when a correction package after a non-clean review changes a publication manifest that already has an in-scope planning-branch commit.

implementation_base_must_contain_publica.description: Require ancestry in the repository that owns the specification revision, not across unrelated Git histories.

baseline_revision.description: Immutable full Git object ID for the canonical-target revision captured before planning-publication adoption; supports SHA-1 and SHA-256 repositories.
